page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head "PRÆFATIO." centred above the text. No marginal notes. Below the text, right of centre, a small "(?) 2" mark.

main_text.p: gius quisquis ille est (nam no-men illius nobis temporum ini-quitas invidet) & eruditissimus scriptor, qui Historiam motuum regni Scotiæ hoc ipso anno nobis dedit p. 245. Tertiò observan-dum, in statu perturbato Ecclesiæ, & quando Magistra-tus supremus officium non face-re vult, Ecclesiam aut saniorem illius partem in extremo pericu-lo religionis constitutam, plus potestatis conjunctâ cum proce-ribus opera exercere posse, quàm ordinariè: similiter & Magi-stratum de procerum & sanio-ris partis Ecclesiæ consilio plus

page.notes: The first word "gius" is a fragment of "magis" or a similar word, cut off at the left edge; kept as printed. The "(?) 2" below the text is doubtful: it may be a catchword, a footnote mark or a stray signature, so it is given as a foot line. The word "Tertiò" is set in larger type within the line; not a heading. Page number and catchword not printed. Digitiser's "Digitized by Google" mark omitted. Small specks and stains in the margins are not text.
